lines.t: A 16 year old made this Roblox game in just a few days.

full.credit: Clips: Maizen; Laughability; FoltynPlays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Grow a Garden came out on March 26th, 2025. You plant seeds, sell crops, and come back later to see them grow.

full.credit: Clips: Maizen; Laughability; FoltynPlays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: A studio partnered with the creator when it only had about 500 players. Then they added weekly updates.

full.credit: Clips: Maizen; Laughability; FoltynPlays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: About three months later, it hit 22 million players at the same time. A world record.

full.credit: Clips: Maizen; Laughability; FoltynPlays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Could you make a game this big?

full.credit: Clips: Maizen; Laughability; FoltynPlays (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
